summary: Describes how the Server-based Certificate Validation Protocol (SCVP) can be used together with Evidence Record Syntax to prove, long afterward, that a signature or certificate path was valid. SCVP lets a server validate a certificate path for a client and can answer for a time in the past, which helps with long-term archives.

eli5.summary: A signed paper can be checked years later, even after the stamp on it expired. This uses a trusted helper to say the stamp was good back then, and keeps that note as proof.
